items.title: US to reduce troops in Europe to 2021 levels, Pentagon says
items.description: The scaling back would bring the number of US troops on the continent to the level before Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine. The Pentagon said that was in line with Trump's 'America first' agenda.

items.title: EU strikes deal on US trade pact ahead of Trump tariff deadline
items.description: The EU reached a provisional agreement to remove import duties on US goods, keeping the bloc on track to meet Trump's deadline to avoid higher tariffs on European exports.
